description:
List Messages

Lists the Project's Messages, with optional resource, conversation, and time filters. Results are eventually consistent.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/messages/list-messages

createdBefore.description: Exclusive upper bound on createdAt, RFC 3339. Cannot combine with updatedAt bounds.

createdSince.description: Inclusive lower bound on createdAt, RFC 3339. Cannot combine with updatedAt bounds.

direction.description: Message origin: received or dispatched, including later delivery outcomes

excludeContentTypes.description: Comma-separated content types to exclude from resource-scoped Message lists and counts. Requires resourceId. A group is excluded when group is selected or all of its parts are excluded; retained Messages are unchanged. Supported values: attachment, group, message.delete, message.read, message.update, poll, poll.update, poll.vote, reaction, space.background.update, space.participants.update, space.profile.share, space.typing.update, text, voice.

order.description: Direction along orderBy; desc, the default, is newest first

orderBy.description: Sort timestamp; defaults to the filtered timestamp, otherwise created_at. Must match the time bounds.

pageSize.description: Items per page. A value above 200 returns at most 200 items.

pageToken.description: Token from nextPageToken. Keep the same Project and query.

perspectiveUserId.description: Selects this User's sent or received Messages. Requires spaceId; cannot combine with resourceId.

platform.description: Restricts the page to one platform

resourceId.description: Resource associated with the Message when sent or received. Can combine with spaceId, but not perspectiveUserId.

spaceId.description: Requires resourceId or perspectiveUserId. User perspectives use created_at order and exclude time bounds and platform filters.

updatedBefore.description: Exclusive upper bound on updatedAt, RFC 3339. Cannot combine with createdAt bounds.

updatedSince.description: Inclusive lower bound on updatedAt, RFC 3339. Cannot combine with createdAt bounds.

confirmedRecipientCount.description: Unique recipients with authoritative delivery confirmation for the original send.

confirmedRecipients.description: Optional complete list of confirmed recipient snapshots, each with a Photon userId and the handle used for the original send. User IDs must be unique, and both fields must be visible to the caller. The list length must equal confirmedRecipientCount. Persist the snapshots with the terminal outcome. Omit when the full confirmed set cannot be identified or disclosed; omission does not mean zero deliveries.
